page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: blank, only show-through of the reverse side (mirrored text). Right page: only a narrow strip at the right edge is visible, cut off by the scan border. It holds a column of italic and large initial letters, with a few short line fragments.
page.notes: Left page: only mirrored show-through from the other side, not transcribed. Right page: the text is cut off at the scan edge, so the lines are fragments and most words are illegible. The large letters D and H and the initial I are likely the first letters of larger words or initials. Their exact reading is uncertain.
